title: py#greengrass-component
description: Add an AWS IoT Greengrass component to a Python project

project.description: The python project to add the Greengrass component to
project.x-prompt: Select the project to add the Greengrass component to

name.description: The name of the component to add
name.x-prompt: What name would you like your Greengrass component to have? i.e: MyComponent

componentName.description: The recipe ComponentName. Defaults to a reversed-domain name derived from your workspace's npm scope and the component name, eg. com.myscope.MyComponent.

componentVersion.description: The initial recipe ComponentVersion. Written into recipe.yaml once; the recipe is user-owned from then on.

publisher.description: The recipe ComponentPublisher. Defaults to the greengrass.publisher set in aws-nx-plugin.config.mts, else your workspace's npm scope.

ipc.description: Whether to wire the Greengrass IPC client (awsiotsdk) and a least-privilege accessControl block scoped to the component's own topic.
ipc.x-prompt: Would you like to use the Greengrass IPC client to publish/subscribe to local topics?

platform.description: The core device platform to vendor Python dependencies for and to write into the recipe manifest.
platform.x-prompt: Which core device platform would you like to target?

preferInstallDependencies.description: Whether to prefer installing dependencies after the generator runs. Set to false to defer installing when batching multiple generators (an install still runs if needed so subsequent generators can compute the Nx project graph); install once at the end.
